name: Career
author: Sixth Front
description: Built into the game and always on: War Thunder style research trees for ships, aircraft, tanks and guns, in the RESEARCH screen (main menu or deploy screen). Winning battles pays research points (RP), silver and gold (a loss pays a quarter). A battle's RP goes into what you are researching in that battle's tree, and into the next modification of what you fought in; anything left over is free RP. Researched vehicles are bought with silver, premium ones with gold (+50% rewards). Only vehicles in your crew slots go into battle, and you always use your own. Every vehicle has modifications (research, buy, switch on) and every gun has its attachments (suppressors, barrels, grips, magazines, lasers, ammunition, finishes: research, buy, equip). New guns: AK-12, SCAR-H, MP5A3, KRISS Vector, Remington 870, M249, PKP, Mk 14 EBR, AWM, Glock 17, Desert Eagle and the premium HK416.

.cr-detail { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: min(380px, 100%); background: rgba(14,16,18,0.96); border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); display: flex; flex-direction: column; z-index: 3; }
.cr-dhead { position: relative; height: 150px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a4046, #23272b); flex: 0 0 auto; }

.cr-dclose { position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 8px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); border: 0; color: #fff; width: 32px; height: 32px; font-size: 1.2rem; cursor: pointer; z-index: 2; }
.cr-dbody { padding: 12px 14px 20px; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.cr-pbar i { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: #e8811c; }

.cr-mods { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }

.cr-mod { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 8px 9px 12px; background: #2c3136; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; color: #eee; font: inherit; min-height: 78px; }
.cr-mod i { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.66rem; color: #a7aca6; line-height: 1.3; }
.cr-mod em { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.74rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-top: auto; }
.cr-mod .cr-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #e8811c; }
.cr-crew { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgba(10,12,14,0.75); overflow-x: auto; flex: 0 0 auto; }

.cr-slot { position: relative; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 196px; height: 92px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #343a40, #24282c); cursor: pointer; color: #fff; padding: 0; font: inherit; text-align: left; overflow: hidden; }
.cr-slot .cr-sh { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 20px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); font: 700 0.74rem var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 2px 7px; }

.cr-slot .cr-nm { position: absolute; right: 7px; top: 22px; font: 700 0.82rem var(--font-ui); text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000; }
.cr-slot .cr-rk { position: absolute; right: 7px; bottom: 3px; font: 800 1.1rem/1 Georgia, serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px #000; }
.cr-slot .cr-empty { position: absolute; inset: 20px 0 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; color: #8f948f; }

.cr-msg { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 112px; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.85); color: #f6c35a; padding: 8px 14px; font: 700 0.8rem var(--font-ui); letter-spacing: 0.08em; z-index: 4; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap; }

.cr-rw-big b { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 1.25rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
#cr-rewards ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-size: 0.74rem; }
